prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original wide scenic establishing illustration of the Shire, the peaceful homeland of hobbits, matching the user's approved latest Rivendell and village pencil scenes. Camera pulled far back and raised to an elevated three-quarter viewpoint, looking across a broad landscape of gently rolling rounded hills, clustered hobbit homes built into grassy banks with distinctive round doors and small round windows, curved garden gates, low dry-stone walls, vegetable plots and cottage flower gardens. A larger well-kept hillside home with a round front door and neat garden is visible in the middle-left foreground but does not dominate; many smaller burrow entrances and smoking little chimneys dot the hills beyond. Winding narrow rural lanes and footpaths connect the homes; a small arched stone bridge crosses a meandering brook near the center, with a modest watermill farther along the stream. Patchwork cultivated fields, hedgerows, old broad-canopied trees, an orchard and low wooded ridges recede into a softly sketched distance. Believable coherent rural geography, a lovingly inhabited countryside rather than a modern village or a grand fantasy city. No foreground people or character portraits; the setting and architecture are the subject. Peaceful, welcoming, homely and pastoral. STYLE: delicate traditional graphite and extremely muted brown-gray pencil drawing on very light near-white warm ivory paper, subtle paper grain, clear expressive fine contours, parallel hatching and fine crosshatching, airy restrained shading, plenty of untouched pale paper between marks. Match the light paper tone of the approved Rivendell image; no orange, peach, yellow or tan wash. Draw architecture selectively, vegetation suggested in rhythmic pencil strokes, distant hills progressively lighter and simpler. Soft daylight conveyed by pale paper and delicate shading, no colored paint, watercolor wash, thick brushwork, heavy black fills, photorealism or 3D rendering. Wide 16:9 full-bleed establishing composition, intended final export 2560x1440. No text, labels, lettering, captions, signs with writing, decorative border, frame, blank bottom strip, black bars, watermark or UI.
